newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian plane detained at Paris till bills paid.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian plane detained at Paris till bills paid.

text.p: A passenger plane belonging to Bulgarian state carrier Balkan Airlines has been detained at Paris's Charles de Gaulle airport until a bill for technical checks has been paid, a transport ministry official said on Monday.
Nor is the airline able to make payment through the International Air Transport Association (IATA) clearing house system as last week IATA stopped it using this facility until it paid its IATA fees.
Balkan, hit by heavy losses in recent years, had leased the detained Boeing 767-200 from Air France.
The airline's debts are expected to increase to $15 million this year, ministry oficials said, adding that the company would try to reschedule its debts.
